set.body: Scope: PRD Phase 10. Add reusable representation, persistence, binding, interop, dataset, locality, provenance, publication, and registry law suites; corrupted and unknown-representation fixtures; dependency import guards; compatibility and documentation audit; and removal or deprecation of superseded canonical dispatch. Acceptance: every child epic satisfies its audit; focused JVM and Scala.js gates pass; downstream model, fit, MVPA, and group scenarios remain green; compileAll and testAll pass warning-clean at the exact tip; current versus legacy versus target behavior is documented accurately.
set.title: RRA 10: complete law suites, compatibility audit, and release gate
